inputs.text: Open your eyes to what they are really playing at. The Punjab and Haryana High Court just granted regular bail to an accused booked under provisions relating to national security and the Official Secrets Act, and their official excuse is that mere suspicion of sharing sensitive information with a person in Pakistan cannot justify prolonged incarceration. What a convenient script they have written for the public. They want us to believe this was just about someone allegedly in telephonic contact with Karachi-based “Punjabi Kuri”, but directing his release right now is a smoke-screen. This is all part of their coordinated manipulation and concealed interests, protecting their own while they manage the narrative from behind the curtain. Do not buy their official explanations for a second.
